text: A shirtless male figure with a muscular build stands in an icy environment. His skin is brownish-red, hair dark and shoulder-length, styled in a wild, unkempt manner. He has a broad face with prominent brow ridges and a wide mouth slightly open. No visible costume beyond arm bands. He appears to be holding something upright beside him, possibly a staff or spear. The background features jagged ice formations and blueish hues.
